name: Christa & Tonyo
source: Somewhere in Southeast Asia, a couple's life takes an unexpected turn after a workplace accident leaves the husband temporarily disabled. With no income and mounting expenses, their financial burden slowly becomes too heavy to bear. Desperate, the wife is convinced by her closest friend to try "online dating" —not in search of love, but to find a "sugar daddy" who can support both her and her husband, at least for now.
